decisions.reason: Retaining project data during the contract upgrade does not change the approved FAQ copy; its mint-number and referral descriptions remain valid unchanged.
The migration decision does not change the recipient, amount, condition, or finalization rules for no-referral commissions.
The contract-upgrade data-retention strategy does not require any change to the About page's approved content.
The migration strategy does not alter the Mission page's approved sections or product-mechanics description.
Data continuity during a contract upgrade does not change the landing hero's wording, layout, or visual-emphasis requirements.
The source changes migration and data-retention behavior, not the VRF provider, eligible population, ticket weighting, or winner-selection method.
Retaining existing project data is governed by the source migration Requirement and does not change the candidate's ticket-counting, display-consistency, or backfill rules.
The migration decision does not alter winner announcement channels, notification channels, email conditions, or winner guidance.
The contract-upgrade strategy has no necessary effect on the landing page's mechanics copy or tone requirements.
Contract data retention is unrelated to the landing-page cover's placement, size, crop, and visibility.
The migration strategy does not modify the established automatic direct-wallet prize-delivery mode.
Retaining backend project data does not change the requirement to publish pool values or display the next-draw sales counter.
